title: A browser tool highlights common LLM writing clichés
friendlyTitle: This free tool finds writing that sounds like a typical AI answer
summary: Simon Willison released a small browser-based tool that highlights sentences matching familiar LLM writing patterns and labels the cliché it detected. Users can paste text or load a public URL, then inspect only the flagged passages.
friendlySummary: Paste in text and the tool highlights common phrases and sentence patterns often used by language models.
whyItMatters: The tool offers a quick editing pass for drafts that sound formulaic, whether or not AI wrote them. A match is a stylistic warning rather than proof of AI authorship, so writers should use it to revise deliberately rather than automatically delete every highlighted phrase.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help make a draft sound less repetitive or mechanical. A highlighted phrase does not prove that AI wrote the text, so use your own judgement.
